concept.concept: Detailed botanical-illustration style grid of six edible wild mushrooms labeled in Latin with a banner reading 'Forager's Field Notes'
concept.audience: Amateur mycologists, cottagecore hobbyists, and nature foragers aged 25-45
concept.rationale: Foraging is a growing passionate niche with dedicated communities, botanical illustration style is trending, Latin labeling adds perceived quality, low competition at this specific angle, perfect for fall season gifting

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Forager's Field Notes" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of six edible wild mushrooms arranged in a 2x3 grid, each mushroom in a simple geometric style with bold outlines and solid color blocks. Mushrooms include: porcini, chanterelle, oyster, shiitake, morel, and lion's mane. Each labeled below with Latin name in small serif capitals. A decorative banner curves across the top with text. Solid color palette: forest green, cream, burnt orange, deep brown, charcoal gray. No gradients, no shading, no photorealism, no drop shadows. Single centered composition on plain pale cream background. All artwork elements stay well within margins.
design.style: Flat vector illustration, bold geometric shapes, clean sharp edges, screen-print aesthetic, limited solid color palette (forest green, cream, burnt orange, deep brown, charcoal), solid color blocks only, no gradients or airbrush shading, high contrast, centered on plain cream background, readable at 12x16 inches

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Forager's Field Notes' is a generic descriptive title combining common English words with no known trademark associations. Botanical illustration style artwork of wild mushrooms with Latin scientific labels is entirely in the public domain as an artistic style and subject matter. No celebrity likenesses, brand names, character IP, song lyrics, or registered slogans are present. The overall concept is a classic naturalist field guide aesthetic with no identifiable IP conflicts.

image_verdict.reason: The design displays 'FORAGER'S FIELD NOTES' correctly spelled and complete. The mushroom illustrations are clean, flat-style icons with accurate labels (Porcini, Chanterelle, Oyster, Shiitake, Morel, Lion's Mane). No IP concerns, no anatomical issues, no rendering artifacts. Clean cream background suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: Forager's Field Notes Botanical Mushroom T-Shirt
